footer.description: Capyra helps creators and agencies turn a public URL or short-video file into structured reading, evidence, recommendations, and a shareable snapshot.
footer.localeHint: Available in PT-BR, EN, and ES.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The page you tried to open does not exist or was removed from the new public landing.

meta.title: Short-video analysis with evidence
meta.description: Capyra turns public URLs and short-video files into structured readings with skills, evidence, recommendations, and shareable snapshots.

hero.title: Capyra reads short videos with evidence ready for decisions.
hero.description: Paste a public URL or upload a file. Capyra keeps the right context, runs specialized skills, and returns what the video communicates, where the evidence appears, and which next test makes sense.

overview.title: Clear reading, real evidence, and a visible next step.
overview.description: The new landing explains the product through what it returns in practice: a short, traceable analysis that is easy to share with a client, creator, or team.

structured.title: Structured reading
structured.description: Capyra organizes theme, hook, structure, CTA, pacing, visuals, and audio in one flow instead of turning the video into a loose list of opinions.

skills.title: Specialized by objective
skills.description: Select skills such as content, filming, editing, audio, or compliance to calibrate the read to the real case.

snapshot.title: Shareable report
snapshot.description: The result can become a frozen snapshot with a revocable token, so you can present evidence without exposing the private workspace.

integrations.title: Use Capyra where creators, agencies, and agents already work.
integrations.description: The web platform remains the center of the product, but the same engine can be triggered by ChatGPT and Claude when the workflow calls for assisted analysis.

chatgpt.title: ChatGPT
chatgpt.description: Connect Capyra MCP to query analyses, create readings, and reuse results inside operational conversations.

claude.title: Claude
claude.description: Use Capyra as an external tool to turn submitted videos or public URLs into structured review material.

workflow.title: From video to result in three moves.
workflow.description: The flow avoids heavy setup before first value: submit the source, choose the focus, and receive a reading ready for action.

input.title: Submit the source
input.description: Paste a public Reels, TikTok, or Shorts URL, or upload the video file when the public source is not enough.

skills.title: Choose the skills
skills.description: Define whether the read should prioritize content strategy, production, editing, audio, music, or compliance.

result.title: Receive the reading
result.description: The response separates observation, inference, limit, and recommendation so the next test is easier to choose.

results.title: The result combines diagnosis, evidence, and recommendation.
results.description: The mock below illustrates the return structure. It shows the types of information the platform organizes without promising native external metrics.

mock.title: Clear hook, late CTA, and a cut opportunity.
mock.description: The analysis records what was observed in the video, where it appears, and which adjustments can be tested in the next piece of content.
mock.evidence0: Hook identified in the first seconds, with a clear promise for the audience.
mock.evidence1: A pacing drop in the middle suggests a cut or caption reinforcement opportunity.
mock.evidence2: CTA appears late; recommendation: move the ask before the closing beat.
mock.snapshotDescription: Generated at analysis time, with a revocable token and enough context for external presentation.

audience.title: Built for people who need to explain performance with evidence.
audience.description: Capyra reduces subjectivity in short-video reviews and turns feedback into actionable material.

agency.title: Agencies
agency.description: Show clients the read with timestamps, limits, and recommendations that support the next test.
agency.bullet0: Turn a public URL or raw file into review material.
agency.bullet1: Use skill-level evidence to justify creative feedback.
agency.bullet2: Generate snapshots for meetings, approvals, and follow-up.

creator.title: Creators
creator.description: Understand what the video communicates, where it loses strength, and what to test without depending on a generic read.
creator.bullet0: Compare hook, structure, CTA, visuals, and audio in one reading.
creator.bullet1: Receive prioritized recommendations for the next version.
creator.bullet2: Use the analysis to repeat patterns that work.

team.title: Internal teams and agents
team.description: Standardize reviews and trigger Capyra through web or MCP when the workflow needs assisted automation.
team.bullet0: Keep source, skills, and result in the same history.
team.bullet1: Use ChatGPT or Claude for assisted workflows.
team.bullet2: Share only the snapshot that is needed.

cta.title: Create an account and generate the first structured reading.
cta.description: Open the app, submit the video source, and see how Capyra turns evidence into a decision.

meta.title: Integrations
meta.description: Short guides for using Capyra with ChatGPT and Claude.

hero.title: Bring Capyra's reading into your workflow.
hero.description: Use the web platform to operate the full product and connect ChatGPT or Claude when you need assisted analysis or structured output outside the main interface.

page.title: Two ways to trigger the same structured reading.
page.description: Each integration uses Capyra as an analysis layer over the API. The web app remains the place for login, authorization, and workspace follow-up.

chatgpt.title: ChatGPT
chatgpt.description: Use the Capyra MCP server to query or start readings during a conversation with campaign, briefing, or review context.
chatgpt.bullet0: Authorize Capyra through OAuth when the MCP client asks for it.
chatgpt.bullet1: Use public URLs or existing assets as analysis input.
chatgpt.bullet2: Return evidence and recommendations without manually copying data across tools.
chatgpt.step: In ChatGPT, add Capyra as an MCP connector using the MCP URL and Client ID below when your account has access to connector flows.

claude.title: Claude
claude.description: Connect Claude to Capyra MCP to turn videos and work context into structured review material.
claude.bullet0: Use the same Capyra login to authorize the external client.
claude.bullet1: Request reads focused on strategy, production, editing, audio, or compliance.
claude.bullet2: Keep the result traceable to the workspace and generated snapshots.
claude.step: In Claude or another remote MCP-compatible client, configure the MCP URL, use the Client ID below, and complete authorization in the browser.

cta.title: Prefer starting in the interface?
cta.description: The web app is the most direct path to create an account, submit the first video, and inspect the full result.
